ONE change: every training fight at difficulty 1.0 (--d-min 1.0 --d-max-start 1.0; run38's ceiling was stuck at 0.95 by the starved gate, OGRL-20261007-012, and never trained at 1.0) -- the project decision of 2026-09-09 (curriculum.ScenarioSampler d_min comment) that run38's launcher silently reverted by copying run30's curriculum (--d-min 0.0). Measured on run38 since 55M (50,148 episodes): U(0,1) put only 7.8% of training fights in the benchmark's cell (1v3, d >= 0.8, win 0.37) -- the same dilution and the same plateau value run21 showed at 279M (6.3%, 0.374). The learnability mix still decides 1v1/1v2/1v3. Question: does training only where the benchmark is raise canonical 1v3 above run38's 124-143/400 (55-75M)?
